title: AI investigation runtime on real cases
scope: Run the approved LangGraph playbooks on real Frappe cases: load case and evidence state, execute the playbook selected for the case, write findings and briefings to the case findings record, pause at human checkpoints and resume from recorded officer decisions

acceptance.text: A worker or outbox handler starts the right playbook when a case is ready; state is loaded from Frappe/Jube records, outputs are written to the TAX-086 findings record with playbook id/version and citations; checkpoints persist outside a local SQLite file or are documented for the demo host; agents run through the model router (live models when keys are configured, recorded fallback otherwise)

For each of SYN-001..SYN-005 a live run produces the expected findings/non-findings and briefing, interrupts for human review, and resumes only after an authorised Frappe decision; no decision is ever taken by the agent
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: For each of SYN-001..SYN-005 a live run produces the expected findings/non-findings and briefing, interrupts for human review, and resumes only after an authorised Frappe decision; no decision is ever taken by the agent
